justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/inline/MethodRebaseResolver.java` is 580 lines and contains 9 nested types: the main interface, `Disabled`, `Resolution`, `Resolution.Preserved`, `Resolution.ForRebasedMethod` with nested `RebasedMethod`, `Resolution.ForRebasedConstructor` with nested `RebasedConstructor`, and `Default` with a `make` factory plus resolver/map logic. That file mixes several distinct responsibilities (strategy contract, no-op implementation, rebased-method modeling, rebased-constructor modeling, and resolution assembly), which is strong evidence of insufficient modularization. The focused tests in `MethodRebaseResolverDefaultTest.java`, `MethodRebaseResolverResolutionPreservedTest.java`, `MethodRebaseResolverResolutionForRebasedMethodTest.java`, and `MethodRebaseResolverResolutionForRebasedConstructorTest.java` also reflect these separate concerns.
